meta.description: Legacy two-threshold router (risk and confidence). Kept as the comparison baseline and for callers that send no assurance signals. Its v1 hash is the value already registered on-chain; v1 does not commit to the nested thresholds object, which is why new policies use v2.

rules: IF riskScore >= 80 AND confidence >= 70 THEN action = REJECT
IF riskScore >= 80 AND confidence < 70 THEN action = HUMAN_REVIEW
